_comment: Vendored snapshot of the 50 Upgrades planner's own meta.json. Every figure here is read from that file and never from the planner's README: the README says 3,533 items and meta.json says 3,653, and printing the wrong one is exactly the propagation fault gate.py exists to catch. Refresh by re-fetching the source URL; do not hand-edit.
